NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IRLY centres the map on where you are when you tap "My location". Your position stays on your phone and is never shared with other members.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IRLY uses the photos you choose for your profile picture, your activities and the moments you post live.
NSMotionUsageDescription: IRLY uses motion to add a subtle depth effect to destination cards.
